qualification.education_qualification: Graduation in any discipline (B.Com/BBA/Inter-CA/Inter-ICWA for Junior Accountant)
qualification.details: Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualifications and experience requirements specified for each post as of the last date of receipt of online application. | Experience Requirements: | Assistant: Six (06) years' relevant office clerical experience in Pay Level-05 (Rs. 29200-92300) or combined service of eight (08) years' relevant office clerical experience in Pay Level-04 (Rs. 25500-81100) and Pay Level-05 (Rs. 29200-92300) for officials of Govt./Autonomous Institutions, OR equivalent relevant service and pay for Non-Govt. officials on contract basis meeting prescribed salary thresholds. Junior Assistant: Five (05) years relevant office clerical experience in Pay Level-03 (Rs. 21700-69100) or eight (08) years relevant office clerical experience in Pay Level-02 (Rs. 19900-63200) for officials of Govt./Autonomous Institutions, OR equivalent relevant service and pay for Non-Govt. officials on contract basis. Junior Accountant: Five (05) years relevant post qualification experience in Pay Level-03 (Rs. 21700-69100) for officials of Govt./Autonomous Institutions, OR equivalent relevant service and pay for Non-Govt. officials on contract basis.

salary_details.details: Regular staff are provided with various other benefits like Accommodation (depending on availability), Medical facility, LTC, National Pension System, etc.

selection_process: The selection process for all posts consists of a Written Test only.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.iimk.ac.in and access the online application portal for advertisement number R-02/2026.
Submit your online application through the portal between 15.10.2026 and 14.11.2026 (up to 23:59 hours).
Pay the prescribed application fee of Rs. 118/- online, if applicable.
Take a printout of the submitted online application and duly sign it.
Enclose self-attested copies of all required documents and certificates.

Send the printed copy of the application by Speed Post / Registered Post / Courier to the designated address, clearly writing on the top left corner of the envelope "Application for the post of ________ Post Code ___".
Postal Address for Sending Applications: HR In-charge, Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode, IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O, Kozhikode, Keralam – 673 570.
important_instructions: Separate application along with relevant supporting documents must be sent and application fee is to be paid for each post. The eligibility, age, qualification, etc. prescribed shall be as on the last date of receipt of online application. Candidates working in Government, Semi-Government, Public Sector, or Autonomous Bodies must forward their applications through proper channel. Incomplete or unsigned applications and applications without proper supporting documents will be summarily rejected. Selected candidates will have to join in the entry pay of the concerned Pay Level of the post. Pay protection benefits will not be extended. Candidates joining the Institute will not be permitted to apply for outside employment for the initial three years. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Assistant Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification advertises a total of 11 regular posts across three designations. The post-wise and category-wise breakdown is detailed below. *Note: The place of initial posting of the candidate selected for the post of Assistant against post reserved for ST category and candidate ranked first in merit under UR category shall be IIMK-Kochi Campus.

content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Assistant Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualifications and experience requirements specified for each post as of the last date of receipt of online application. Experience Requirements: Assistant: Six (06) years' relevant office clerical experience in Pay Level-05 (Rs. 29200-92300) or combined service of eight (08) years' relevant office clerical experience in Pay Level-04 (Rs. 25500-81100) and Pay Level-05 (Rs. 29200-92300) for officials of Govt./Autonomous Institutions, OR equivalent relevant service and pay for Non-Govt. officials on contract basis meeting prescribed salary thresholds. Junior Assistant: Five (05) years relevant office clerical experience in Pay Level-03 (Rs. 21700-69100) or eight (08) years relevant office clerical experience in Pay Level-02 (Rs. 19900-63200) for officials of Govt./Autonomous Institutions, OR equivalent relevant service and pay for Non-Govt. officials on contract basis. Junior Accountant: Five (05) years relevant post qualification experience in Pay Level-03 (Rs. 21700-69100) for officials of Govt./Autonomous Institutions, OR equivalent relevant service and pay for Non-Govt. officials on contract basis.

content_sections.text: Postal Address for Sending Applications: HR In-charge, Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode, IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O, Kozhikode, Keralam – 673 570.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSLC as proof of date of birth. Proof of Educational qualification (Final year mark sheet to be produced at the time of Written Test/interview). Experience certificate (from latest employment to earlier ones clearly mentioning period of employment). Proof of the salary drawn during the total period of experience claimed i.e. initial salary proof, proof of change of salary/pay level, latest salary proof. Community certificate for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EWS in the format prescribed by the Govt. of India. Vigilance Clearance Certificate from the current employer (if applicable). Discharge Certificate for Ex-servicemen / Medical Certificate from Medical Board for PwD.

content_sections.text: Separate application along with relevant supporting documents must be sent and application fee is to be paid for each post. The eligibility, age, qualification, etc. prescribed shall be as on the last date of receipt of online application. Candidates working in Government, Semi-Government, Public Sector, or Autonomous Bodies must forward their applications through proper channel. Incomplete or unsigned applications and applications without proper supporting documents will be summarily rejected. Selected candidates will have to join in the entry pay of the concerned Pay Level of the post. Pay protection benefits will not be extended. Candidates joining the Institute will not be permitted to apply for outside employment for the initial three years. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced in IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 11 regular vacancies have been announced under advertisement number R-02/2026 across Assistant, Junior Assistant, and Junior Accountant posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14 November 2026 up to 23:59 hours.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for receiving the printed copy of the application at IIMK?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the printed copy of the application along with relevant documents at IIMK is 23 November 2026 up to 17:30 hours.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess graduation in any discipline along with six years of relevant office clerical experience in Pay Level-05 or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 118/- inclusive of GST for General category candidates, while SC, ST, Differently Abled, Women, and departmental candidates of IIMK are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for IIM Kozhikode Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with age relaxations up to 40 years for SC/ST and 38 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a Written Test only.

faq.question: Q8. Where should candidates send the printed copy of their application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by Speed Post, Registered Post, or Courier to the HR In-charge, Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode, IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O, Kozhikode, Keralam – 673 570.
